Could interpret as "What is the probability distribution of the number of heads when tossing 3 coins?" Or maybe they want the expected number of heads? But the phrasing "How many heads can I get" suggests they want the possible outcomes: 0,1,2,3 heads. Or maybe they want the probability of each outcome. The user didn't specify format. We could respond with the probabilities: 0 heads: 1/8, 1 head: 3/8, 2 heads: 3/8, 3 heads: 1/8. Or we could give the expected value: 1.5 heads.
